headline: Chinese Developers Eye Sri Lanka Property Boom Amid Lingering Risks
summary: A luxury property boom in Sri Lanka is lifting market sentiment and drawing optimism from Chinese developers, though analysts warn of past speculative excess and potential boom-to-bust cycles.
why: Cross-border real estate investments expose emerging market developers to currency fluctuations, regulatory changes, and macroeconomic instability.

impacts.name: Real Estate
impacts.why: Inflows of foreign capital into commercial and residential developments boost local property market valuations.
